assets.name: six-leaf-blue-vine
assets.description: A winding blue vine with six pointed leaves in red, blue and green, with opaque pale tips and white painted highlights.

provenance.institution: Free Library of Philadelphia, John Frederick Lewis Collection
provenance.title: Decorated initial Q
provenance.object_identifier: Lewis E M 12:4 Decorated initial Q
provenance.image_rights: Public Domain Mark 1.0; item record explicitly places images in public domain

extraction.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / faithful historical foreground extraction. Edit target: the supplied original manuscript detail. Extract The entire interior blue winding vine with six original pointed leaves: three orange-red leaves, two blue leaves and one green leaf. Remove the pink Q letter, gold field and separate colored dots. All spaces between leaves and stems must be transparent; preserve original white painted leaf tips and fine white stem highlights. Do not add a leaf or change the vine turns. Keep the exact original pose, shapes, colors, proportions and fine ink or painted lines. Output on a genuinely transparent background, with small transparent padding. Remove lettering, parchment, stains, chart, ruler and surrounding ground color. No new details, reconstruction, modern redraw, shadows, glow, smoothing or background rectangle.
extraction.method: AI-assisted foreground extraction; transparent alpha retained, resolution capped to source region and transparent exterior trimmed.
extraction.source_pixels_redrawn: AI extraction may alter scan texture, tones or small contours; compare against the retained original source.

review.reason: Rechecking silhouette, completeness, native scale, interior holes and SVG fidelity following user-reported failures.
checks: User identified this as a good extraction.

previous_review.notes: Original motif compared with extraction on white and dark backgrounds: source pose, principal painted shapes, terminals and pale highlights retained. Actual openings cleared; initial glyph and flat gold/black fields removed. AI-assisted extraction approximates paint texture and some small contours.
